LanguageData.LiAIChat_SporeBioengineering.label: Spore Bioengineering
LanguageData.LiAIChat_SporeBioengineering.description: Study the structure and controlled behavior of Blightfall spores. Requires the Spore Bioengineering blueprint and 3 units of Blight research data when research begins.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_CorrosiveTechnology.label: Corrosive Technology
LanguageData.LiAIChat_CorrosiveTechnology.description: Study the Blightfall's corrosive compounds and how to control them. Requires the Corrosive Technology blueprint and 4 units of Blight research data when research begins.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_SymbioticArmor.label: Symbiotic Armor
LanguageData.LiAIChat_SymbioticArmor.description: Develop a living protective shell from symbiotic Blightfall organisms. Requires the Symbiotic Armor blueprint and 5 units of Blight research data when research begins.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_ResonanceTechnology.label: Resonance Technology
LanguageData.LiAIChat_ResonanceTechnology.description: Analyze the resonance structures used by the Blightfall network. Requires the Resonance Technology blueprint and 6 units of Blight research data when research begins.
LanguageData.LiAIChat_PhaseveilTechnology.label: Phaseveil Technology
LanguageData.LiAIChat_PhaseveilTechnology.description: Study how the Blightfall distorts local space and visibility. Requires the Phaseveil Technology blueprint and 8 units of Blight research data when research begins.
